input_sentence: Anthropic released a new Claude model with major performance gains.
headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 with Sweeping Performance Leaps
dek: Fable 5 claims state-of-the-art across coding, vision, and scientific research, while Mythos 5 extends AI into autonomous drug design and genomics — both at half the price of the previous Mythos Preview.

hero_image.caption: Anthropic's official announcement of Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, published June 9, 2026.

summary: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 on June 9, 2026, marking the first public release of a Mythos-class model. Fable 5 is available to Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users and tops nearly every benchmark Anthropic tested, while Mythos 5 — sharing the same underlying model but with fewer safety restrictions — is reserved for roughly 200 approved institutions via Project Glasswing. On the SWE-Bench Pro software engineering benchmark, Fable 5 scores 80.3%, well ahead of rivals GPT-5.5 (58.6%) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (54.2%). Both models are priced at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens — less than half the cost of Claude Mythos Preview.

reactions.take: Fable 5 compressed five months of engineering work into days; completed a codebase-wide migration of a 50M-line Ruby repo in one day that would otherwise have taken a full team over two months.
Fable 5 passed their trading analysis evaluations almost across the board, including factual lookup, conceptual reasoning, root-cause analysis, and expected-value analysis.

Mythos 5 accelerated parts of the drug design process by around 10×; the model matched or beat skilled human operators when working with protein design and bioinformatics tools without human assistance.

Mythos 5 is the first model to consistently produce novel, compelling scientific hypotheses; one E. coli protein mechanism hypothesis was corroborated by an independent lab working on the same problem.

Flagged that the price jump to $10/M input tokens is nearly double that of Claude Opus 4.8, and that Fable 5 is no longer included in standard subscription plans after June 22 — noting token efficiency per task remains to be determined.

why_it_matters: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 represent a new performance tier that Anthropic claims surpasses all of its prior generally available models and key rivals in coding, scientific reasoning, and vision — with real-world validation from companies like Stripe and IMC. The dual-model strategy, separating a safety-guardrailed public model from a restricted, higher-capability research model, sets a precedent for how frontier AI labs might responsibly release increasingly powerful systems. Mythos 5's autonomous drug design and genomics results, if independently validated, could mark a concrete step toward AI-accelerated scientific discovery.
whats_next: June 23, 2026: Fable 5's free inclusion period on Claude.ai subscription plans ends; usage credits may be required until capacity expands.
Planned expansion of Mythos 5 access beyond Project Glasswing via a broader Trusted Access Program.
Planned launch of a Trusted Access Program for biology researchers (Fable 5 without bio/chemistry safeguards).
Anthropic to publish autonomous genomics research results from Mythos 5 in the coming months.
Continued improvement of Fable 5 safety guardrails to reduce false-positive triggers below the current <5% rate.
Watch for independent benchmark validation and competitor responses from OpenAI and Google.

extras.rollout_status: Fable 5 is available immediately on Claude.ai Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans, and via the Claude API. Mythos 5 is restricted to ~200 Project Glasswing partner institutions in collaboration with the US government; a broader Trusted Access Program is planned. A Trusted Access Program for biology researchers (with bio/chemistry safeguards lifted but cyber safeguards retained) is also forthcoming.
